description: This file provides functions to interact with memory technology device (mtd) partitions, specifically for reading and writing bytes, and setting flags on devices manufactured by MSTC. It includes utility functions for error handling, reading/writing bytes, and configuring device-specific flags, primarily for embedded Linux systems that use UBI/MTD devices.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure by notifying, unmounting all filesystems, and rebooting the system.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte at a specified offset in an mtd device. When provided, writes the byte; otherwise, reads the byte.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a flag value at a specific offset in an mtd device for MSTC devices. Validates current flag value before updating.
